description: This file is a Perl module ('metadata.pm') that defines functions and variables for parsing and handling package and target metadata within a build system or package management context. It includes functions for parsing package metadata files, target metadata files, and package manifest files, as well as managing internal data structures for packages, categories, and user/group identifiers.

methods.name: get_multiline
methods.description: Reads multiple lines from a file handle until a line starting with '@@' is encountered; concatenates and returns the accumulated string.

methods.name: confstr
methods.description: Transforms a configuration string by replacing certain characters with underscores.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata_usergroup
methods.description: Parses user or group specification strings, validates IDs and names, and updates provided hash references.

methods.name: parse_target_metadata
methods.description: Parses a target metadata file, extracting information about build targets, profiles, dependencies, and associated attributes into data structures.

methods.name: clear_packages
methods.description: Resets internal hash variables storing package, category, and user/group data.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Parses a package metadata file, extracting package details, dependencies, source info, categories, and other attributes into internal data structures.

methods.name: parse_package_manifest_metadata
methods.description: Parses a package manifest file, extracting package information such as dependencies, sources, license, size, and filename.
